name: Blueberry Diesel 1g Live Resin Disposable
description:
Lineage: (Bluedream x Cookie) x Chemchee x Planet Purple F2

Breeder: Archive Seed Bank

Terpenes: Linalool, Caryphyllene, Myrcene

Effects: Euphoric, Relaxed, Happy

Aroma: Fruity, Diesel like, Earthy 

Strap in and take off with BlueBerry Diesel, a strain that blends the juicy sweetness of blueberries with a gritty edge of fuel. This hybrid powers your mood into a euphoric lift while gently cruising your body into relaxation. With each inhale, you get a hit of ripe berry flavor followed by a gritty, skunky undertone, like nature and machinery colliding in perfect harmony. Whether you're chasing creativity, winding down, or just vibing, BlueBerry Diesel delivers a ride where the line between sweet serenity and high-octane bliss blurs beautifully.
